messages:
ana (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about reviews / leveling / comp. I'll capture the short answers here and link follow-ups.

michael (Eng Manager): Timeline question — when will managers get final calibration decisions?

ana (People Ops): Good q. Calibration meetings are next Tue/Wed. Managers will get results in Workday by end of week (expect an email from people-ops). Promotions finalized and routed to payroll for the next cycle (effective date shown in the offer/Workday entry). :memo:

sophia (IC): For promotions, is the expectation doc still the single source? And can L4->L5 be appealed if you miss this cycle?

ana (People Ops): Yes — the leveling rubric (linked in #docs) is the source of truth for competencies. If you miss this cycle, you can do an appeal: 1) talk to your manager, 2) manager blocks for calibration, 3) if still disagree, submit the appeals form (link below). Appeals are reviewed in the next calibration window. Appeals form: <https://redwood.company/hr/appeals>

derek (CEO): Quick note — leadership asks managers to include concrete impact examples in packets (metrics, customer outcomes, PRs merged) — makes calibrations faster.

michael (Eng Manager): Thanks — can managers see example language?

ana (People Ops): Yes, we published sample promo packets in the docs repo. Example snippet: ```Impact: reduced per-token cost by 22% via batching changes; shipped batching config to prod; reduced 95th p90 latency by 60ms.``` Use bullet points and attach 1-2 supporting PRs.

lina (Benefits): On benefits/open enrollment Q from the all-hands — open enrollment starts 10/15 and lasts two weeks. We'll do two walkthrough sessions (recorded). Any changes to the medical plan or HSA contribution limits will be in the benefits summary we post next Monday.

sophia (IC): About comp adjustments — will there be market-based increases separate from promotions/merit?

ana (People Ops): We have two levers: promotions and market adjustments. Market adjustments are limited and targeted (role/benchmarks). If your manager flagged a market concern during calibration, you may see a market adjustment; otherwise merit/promo is the path.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Office hours with People Ops tomorrow 2–4pm PST. Book via the calendar link posted earlier. :calendar:

michael (Eng Manager): If a team wants to nominate someone for an interim promotion between cycles, is that supported?

ana (People Ops): Interims are rare. We do make exceptions for manager escalations with documented impact and sponsorship from a director. That goes to the compensation committee; expect ~2–3 weeks for decision. Use subject `Interim Promo Request: <name>` when emailing people-ops.

sophia (IC): One last ask — can we get a short FAQ doc for ICs summarizing timelines and next steps?

ana (People Ops): Yep — I'll drop an FAQ and the timeline in #docs by EOD tomorrow. If you want a 1:1, book office hours or DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
